config.description: Top-level configuration container for rebuildctl settings. Note: This template uses a flat structure for simplicity in schema definition, but the values are passed as a single object `config` in the sample. In a real Jinja2 engine, you would likely flatten this or pass the object directly. For strict adherence to 'flat map' in schema, we define the keys directly under the root if the engine supports it, but here we assume the template accesses `config.key`. To conform to the 'NO nested object' rule in schema defaults, we will actually flatten the template variables to be top-level, which is more standard for this type of request.
